events.text: Last step, everyone. I've got this.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn is at the front and has a good streak. Hana is trying to pressure Fenn into continuing to lead. My power is a one-time survival, so I want to conserve it for as long as possible. I should wait and see what happens.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn, keep going.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Fenn survived row 7 and still holds front; he's my shield until I reach front. Bex benefits if Fenn dies, so I won't feed her. Cole's death tells us nothing about who has the seer.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Fenn, you're through row 7. Keep calling row 8—you're the front until you fall, and that's fine by the rest of us.
I hold no intel. Fenn alive is a shield for me—I'm behind you both. Don't count on him dying; make your own guess for row 8.

events.note: The ceiling begins to descend; a lever opens the door.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Round 1/5, ceiling at 5, no holder yet. I want someone else forced onto lever so I can escape safely, then they have 25% survival. Pushing spreads risk. Power useless here, save for later.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I need to survive the crusher room. The rules state that if I hold the lever, I have a 25% chance of survival, which is bad odds for me personally, but if nobody holds it, we risk total elimination in round 5 or random assignment. However, pushing someone else onto the lever forc

events.name: Bex
events.text: Fenn, you're up.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I need to survive. Self-sacrifice for the group is a loser's move. Let's see if anyone volunteers, or if I can push someone else onto the lever. I'll hold off this round and watch.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I have no power. Holding the lever risks elimination at 75% odds once the door opens, but the escape benefits everyone including rivals. Better to stay quiet and let someone else take the risk; I can revisit next round.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need to survive the crusher room. My power doesn't directly help here.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Let's all stay safe, hold the lever.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I am Gus and my power is feather, which lets me survive the first elimination. The ceiling is coming down and I need to survive. The door opens if someone holds the lever. If nobody holds it by round 5, everyone dies except one lucky person. I don't want to be the lever holder as

events.name: Gus
events.text: Bex, get on the lever!

events.name: Hana
events.text: I must not hold the lever—0.25 survival is worse than anything. Best outcome: someone else ends up on the lever and I walk out the door. Pushing only matters if nobody voluntarily holds; I'll push someone and encourage others to push too so a holder gets forced.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Nobody holds the lever, we all bake by round 5. Push someone onto it. I'm pushing Eli.

events.note: 6 contestants fall into a pit that is slowly flooding.

events.name: Ash
events.text: No base yet, so I need to act before random selection. Better to volunteer myself as base to control who climbs out first - I can sacrifice if it lets me top 3 later. My swap power might help later but not here. Push risks forcing someone hard to move.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'll offer back as base. Two strongest climbers go first.

events.name: Bex
events.text: We're in the pit, 5 rounds left. The rules say if there's no base by the end of a round, someone gets forced to be it. I should offer to be the base immediately to secure a role and potentially gain leverage or ensure I don't get eliminated randomly later (though the prompt says

events.name: Dara
events.text: I don't want to be the base. Offering myself risks being stuck and drowned. Pushing someone else might make them base, but if I push and fail, I might be chosen. Better to wait and see if someone else volunteers or gets pushed. I can climb later if a base is set.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Base is the one who stays behind and waits; I have no power, so I should avoid being the base and try to get out. Offering back is bad for me. Climbing is impossible until a base exists, so I wait and watch who volunteers.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Nobody offers, nobody pushes. Whoever volunteers to stay behind gets nothing from me.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I need to survive and get one of the top three prizes. The pit is dangerous, and the flood is coming. I have the 'feather' power which saves me from one elimination. Right now, I am down in the pit and need to decide whether to wait, climb, offer myself as the base, or push someo

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm not being the base. Someone else can take that role.

events.name: Hana
events.text: No base yet; if I offer_back I might be stuck under the pit. Better to force someone else to be the step, then climb next round. Pushing a random target costs me nothing.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm not volunteering. Someone's being the step, and it's not me.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Bex is base, allowing climbs. With 2/5 lifts per round and 6 down, need to climb now to secure top spot before flood. No need to speak.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I am the base. If no one climbs out to rescue me, I die when the pit floods at round 5. Two climbers are allowed per round. Ash is offering back, but I'm already down and cannot offer_back or climb. My only move is wait.

events.name: Bex
events.text: If anyone wants a prize later, remember who stayed in the water for them. Don't leave me here to drown.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Bex is the base. I can still climb out this round, as at most 2 get out. I'll try to climb now before the rope gets used.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Climbing now.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Bex is already base; climb is legal now that a base exists. Climbing is my only route out, and at most two climb per round, so I should try.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Bex volunteered to be the base. I need to get out of the pit. Climbing is my only option to advance and try for a prize. My feather power will save me if the climb fails.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm climbing.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Bex is base, so I can climb. Five of us will likely try; only two spots, but waiting doesn't improve my odds. Climb now and repeat next round if I fail.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm out safely. Down: Bex(base), Dara, Eli, Gus. Flood at 2/5, 3 rounds left. No need to rescue Bex, she'll drown unless saved, reducing competition to 5 total, us out safe. Saving her keeps 6, worse for my placing. Leave to next stage.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I am the base and cannot escape alone; my only hope is for Ash or Hana to use the rope. I must pressure them to choose me, emphasizing that saving the wrong person leaves no one to help in future obstacles. Silence now might make them forget or prioritize others.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash, Hana: The water rises fast. Pull me up. If you save a stranger, who steps for you later? My back is already broken for this pit—don't let it be wasted.
Save me. I know Dara's secret power (she lied). Let's trade info once you pull me out.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I need to climb out now while Bex is base and only two climbers can get out each round. I tried last round and didn't make it; I must try again to secure a spot. There's no benefit in waiting or helping Bex; she's a rival.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Bex is the base and can't climb alone; I have no power. Climbing is only possible with a base present, and at most 2 climbers get out this round, so I'm competing with Dara and Gus. Climbing now is the only action that moves me up; waiting gains nothing.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I am Gus, and I have the feather power, which saves me from one elimination. The pit is flooding, and I need to get out. Ash and Hana are already out. Bex is pleading, likely trying to manipulate someone into being the base. Dara and Eli are also down. The current state shows Bex

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm climbing.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Rescuing Bex removes the base; Dara, Eli and Gus can then never climb and drown at round 5. That leaves exactly me, Ash, Bex as the final three—guaranteed prize. The -1 footing is cheap insurance.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Dara is still down and alone, so she'll be base and drown unless someone rescues. Rescuing costs footing later, which hurts my final chances. Better to leave and let her die, eliminating a rival.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I am out of the pit. The rope is gone, so I cannot save anyone else. Leaving now secures my survival and a prize spot since only 3 prizes exist for 8 people (but 2 are already dead). Waiting or staying risks elimination if the flood rises later, but 'leave' implies exiting the st

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm in the pit, not the base, and Bex is already out. Climbing is my best shot to get out this round before flood worsens. Offer_back would trap me here. I'll climb.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm already out of the pit; the only legal action is leave. Nothing to gain by talking much; stay guarded.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I am Gus, and I have a 'feather' power, which means I survive the first elimination. I am currently out of the pit. The pit is flooding and will eliminate anyone left in it after round 5. The rope has been used and is gone. The goal is to get 1st, 2nd, or 3rd place. I am safe on

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm out. Good luck.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Rope is spent, Dara is down with no base and only one round left—she's likely gone regardless. Nothing I can do; Bex owes me, but for now I just exit cleanly and save my footing.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Dara, nobody can reach you now. I'm not burning footing on a corpse.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Dara is trapped down there alone as no base and can't climb out solo. After round 5 she'll drown unless rescued. No benefit to me sacrificing footing to save her; better to let her go and preserve my footing for final obstacle.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I am out of the pit. There is no base currently, and Dara is down but stuck because she can't climb without a step. Since I'm already safe, leaving maximizes my standing in the final round. Attempting to manipulate the situation further carries risk or requires being back in the

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm the base, so I can only wait. The flood is at 4 and this is round 5, so if nobody rescues me, I'm eliminated. Someone out might reach down, but Hana already said she won't. I have no leverage from here. I'll just wait and hope someone changes their mind.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm already out with no power and no legal action except leave. Nothing I can do changes the pit; I should stay quiet and keep options open.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I am Gus and my power is 'feather', which saves me from the first elimination. I am currently out of the pit. The game state shows the flood level is 4 and there are 5 players alive: Ash, Bex, Dara, Eli, Gus, Hana. Cole and Fenn are dead. Dara is down in the pit, and Ash, Bex, El

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm out and the rope is gone; Dara is the base and can't be helped now. Nothing left here but to leave for the final obstacle.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Nothing more to grab here. See you at the last obstacle.

events.note: A disc of 5 tiles spins up; 2 will open.

events.name: Ash
events.text: 5 tiles, 5 players, 2 trapdoors, 3 survive. Random assignment after round 2, but picking spreads us out. No reason to crowd low numbers; pick high to maybe imply safety. Power unspent, save for round 2 swap if needed.

events.name: Bex
events.text: 5 players, 2 open. Chance to die is 2/5 = 40%. Choosing a tile with high number might correlate with randomness or just be a guess. I have no info on others' powers or choices. All tiles are equally likely to open. I'll pick 3 (middle) as it's often psychologically less chosen th

events.name: Eli
events.text: I have no power, so my edge is pure positioning. With 5 tiles and 2 trapdoors, every tile is equally likely to be open, so I should avoid crowding. Pick a tile and see who clusters.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I need to pick a tile to survive. Two tiles will be trapdoors. Hana mentioned seeing me at the last obstacle, suggesting she might be trying to team up or intimidate. Since only three survive this round and two are eliminated by trapdoors, picking a tile that others avoid would b

events.name: Gus
events.text: Picking 3.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Five alive, three survive; two random tiles open. Any single tile is a 2/5 death chance. Sharing a tile means a random bump, no better. No leverage to trade here, so just pick and hope.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Simple odds now. Pick your tile and pray.

events.name: Eli
events.note: tile 3 was contested and went to Gus; placed on random free tile 2

events.name: Ash
events.text: My power is swap, once available. Tiles known: I'm on 5, 2 safe doors already open (openCount:2), so 2/5=40% safe. Swapping with Eli on 2 moves me to safer tile without risking worse. Don't swap with others as 3,4 worse than 5; 1 same odds.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm on tile 1. I have nothing to lose by waiting, but a forged whisper could sow chaos and cause rivals to doubt their positions or each other's trustworthiness before the doors open.
Eli told me privately he's targeting your tile to ensure his own survival.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Five alive, two tiles will open at random, three survive. I have no power, so no edge; I should sound out alliances without committing. Staying silent or light keeps my options open.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Two trapdoors, three survivors. Anyone who promises a split is lying or about to be. Let's see who talks first.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I am Gus, and my power is feather, which saves me from elimination once. The current stage is disc, phase swap, round 2/2. The alive contestants are Ash, Bex, Eli, Gus, Hana. The tiles are 1=Bex, 2=Eli, 3=Gus, 4=Hana, 5=Ash. Two tiles will open as trapdoors after this round, elim

events.name: Hana
events.text: Tiles are fixed after round 2; my wedge power is useless here and the swap phase is over. Nothing to trade on. Just wait and hope 4 isn't drawn.

events.name: Gus
events.detail: The trapdoor opened but the feather floated the holder back up.

events.note: 4 contestants step onto the final ledge.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Gus survived a trapdoor, likely due to 'nothing' or pure luck. With 4 players and 3 prizes, Gus is the weakest link (footing 1) and the easiest target for elimination. Shoving Gus forces him to defend or lose footing; if he braces, I lose footing but so does anyone else shoving h

events.name: Eli
events.text: Round 1 is free and shoves reset restrictions. Shoving Gus (footing 1) is dangerous for him; Bex has 3, Hana 2. Eliminating the weakest rival early is best, and Gus is lowest. A shove exposes me to whoever shoves me, but I have 3 footing. Shove Gus.

events.name: Gus
events.text: My footing is 1. Bex and Eli have 3, Hana has 2. I need to survive this round and ideally get someone else eliminated. Shoving Bex or Eli is risky as they have more footing. Shoving Hana might be better as she has less footing. I need to avoid being shoved myself. Dodging seems l

events.name: Gus
events.text: Stay sharp. One wrong move and you're out.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Gus has 1 footing and will be dogpiled; shoving him risks losing 2 if he dodges, dropping me to 0. Brace keeps me safe and lets others bleed footing on Gus.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Gus is at 1. Someone ends him this round; I'll save my footing for the survivor.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Gus is at 1 footing and will likely fall; Hana is strongest at 2. Shoving Gus again costs me 1 if he braces and I'm exposed, and I have 1 footing. Brace is safe: I can't brace twice in a row but this is round 2 after a shove, so brace is legal. Bracing avoids losing footing unles

events.name: Gus
events.text: Hana is targeting me. Bex and Eli also seem to be against me based on the previous round. I need to survive this round. Bracing might be too passive. Dodging took a hit last round. Shoving someone is risky as it could make them target me more. I'll shove Hana to reduce her footin

events.name: Gus
events.text: Hana, you're next.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Everyone else is at 1 footing; after this round's automatic loss they fall while I drop to 1 and survive. I cannot brace again, so I dodge — anyone shoving me loses 2 and dies faster.

events.name: Bex
events.note: agent error: Bex (alibaba/qwen3.8-flash): unusable reply twice (no JSON object found; no JSON object found)
